target.title: fix(channels): clear stale narration drafts when narration stops
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Discord progress narration could leave a stale narration-only draft visible when narration stopped and the progress draft had no real fallback progress lines to render.

## Why This Change Was Made

The channel progress compositor already treats an empty narration update as the signal to fall back from utility-model narration to normal progress content. This change keeps that boundary complete by deleting the current draft when deletion is available and the fallback would otherwise render empty or label-only, while preserving visible fallback updates for channels without draft deletion and for drafts that still have tool, reasoning, or commentary progress lines.

This PR is AI-assisted.

## User Impact

Users no longer see outdated live status text linger in progress draft mode when narration is disabled mid-turn and there is no remaining progress content to show.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: clearing narration removes a narration-only draft when draft deletion is available, falls back to a label-only update when deletion is unavailable, and existing fallback-to-tool-lines behavior remains covered in the same focused test file.
- Current-head proof at `1ad0859913d49e789ba3b6e69b9419660d3ccf30`: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/channels/progress-draft-compositor.test.ts` passed with 1 file and 17 tests passing.
- Focused lint proof: `oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/channels/progress-draft-compositor.ts` passed for the touched file.
- PR diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed.
- Observed result: with `deleteCurrent`, a cleared narration-only draft invokes `deleteCurrent` without emitting a label-only draft update; without `deleteCurrent`, the compositor edits the draft back to the label fallback instead of leaving the old narration visible; when fallback content exists, it still renders the fallback draft.
